interactions.message: Hi, I've been charged twice for my Pro plan subscription this month. My card shows two debits of ₹1,499 on Sept 18. Can you help?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent verified billing records and confirmed duplicate charge. Initiated a refund request for the second charge via the payment gateway.

interactions.message: Following up on my duplicate charge issue (ref: INT-001). It has been 2 days and I still don't see the refund in my account. This is very frustrating.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent escalated to the finance team and provided an estimated refund timeline of 3-5 business days. Sent confirmation email with refund tracking ID.

interactions.message: This is my THIRD time contacting you about the duplicate billing charge. I was told 3-5 business days and it's now been a week. I want to speak to a manager. If this isn't resolved today I'm cancelling my subscription.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent attempted to fast-track the refund with finance but the finance team's queue is backed up. Offered a one-month credit as goodwill while the refund processes.

interactions.message: I just got another email saying my refund is 'being processed'. It's been 9 days. I've already filed a dispute with my bank. Absolutely unacceptable service.
interactions.attempted_fix: Senior agent confirmed the refund was stuck in an approval loop. Manually processed the refund and sent immediate confirmation. Offered two months free as compensation.

interactions.message: I'm unable to export my project data as CSV. Every time I click the export button, I get a 500 error. I need this data for a client presentation tomorrow morning.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent reproduced the bug and filed an engineering ticket (ENG-4521). Provided a workaround using the API endpoint to export data as JSON, then convert to CSV locally.

interactions.message: Thanks for the workaround on the CSV export. That saved my presentation. Just wanted to let you know the API method worked perfectly. When will the button be fixed though?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent checked engineering ticket status — fix is scheduled for next sprint (v2.14). Shared the release timeline with the customer.

interactions.message: How do I add team members to my workspace? I upgraded to the Team plan but I can't find the invite option anywhere in the settings.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent walked the customer through Settings → Team Management → Invite Members. The option was hidden because the customer's account upgrade hadn't fully propagated. Agent triggered a manual sync.

interactions.message: I invited 3 team members yesterday but they say they never received the invitation emails. Can you check if the invites went out?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent checked the email delivery logs and found that invite emails were queued but not sent due to a misconfigured SMTP relay. Re-sent invitations manually and confirmed delivery.

interactions.message: Everything is working great now with the team setup. Just calling to ask — is there a way to set different permission levels for different team members? I want some people to only view, not edit.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent explained the role-based access control (RBAC) feature available on the Team plan. Walked the customer through setting Viewer, Editor, and Admin roles for each member.

interactions.message: I'm trying to integrate your API with our Salesforce instance but the webhook endpoint keeps returning 403 Forbidden errors. I've double-checked the API key.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent identified that the customer's API key had 'read-only' scope. Guided the customer to generate a new key with 'read-write' and 'webhook' scopes enabled.

interactions.message: I regenerated the API key with the right scopes as instructed, but now I'm getting a different error: 'payload too large'. My webhook payload is only 2KB. Is there a size limit I'm not seeing?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent discovered the 'payload too large' error was a known bug in API v2.3 affecting webhook payloads with nested JSON arrays. Recommended the customer switch to API v2.4-beta which has the fix.

interactions.message: Switching to v2.4-beta fixed the payload issue, but now the webhook fires twice for every event. I'm getting duplicate records in Salesforce. This integration has been a nightmare. We have a go-live deadline next Monday.
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent reproduced the duplicate-firing issue and filed a critical bug report (ENG-4589). Suggested implementing idempotency checks on the Salesforce side as a temporary workaround using the event_id field.

interactions.message: I'd like to upgrade from the Starter plan to the Business plan. Can you walk me through what changes and whether I'll lose any of my current data or settings?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent provided a detailed comparison of Starter vs Business plan features. Confirmed that all data, settings, and integrations carry over seamlessly during upgrade. Shared a link to the upgrade page.

interactions.message: I just completed the upgrade to Business plan. Everything looks good! One question — the advanced analytics dashboard is showing 'No data available'. Is there a delay before it starts populating?
interactions.attempted_fix: Agent explained that the analytics dashboard requires a 24-hour data collection window after plan upgrade before metrics appear. Set a reminder to follow up with the customer in 24 hours.
